# Support

## Getting Help

If you need help with PrintBit, use the appropriate channel:

### Questions / Usage Help

Use GitHub Discussions:

- Ask setup questions
- Troubleshoot printing issues
- Clarify expected behavior

### Bug Reports

Use the Bug Report issue template:

- Reproducible errors
- Printing failures
- System crashes

### Feature Requests

Use the Feature Request template:

- New capabilities
- Improvements to existing flows

---

## Before Asking for Help

Please include:

- Clear description of the problem
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)
- Environment:
  - Local or kiosk
  - OS
  - Printer model

- Logs or error messages

Incomplete reports will slow down debugging.

---

## Hardware-Related Issues

PrintBit depends on external hardware and tools:

- Printer availability and status
- External binaries (GhostScript, LibreOffice, etc.)

Always verify:

- Printer is connected and online
- Required dependencies are installed
- No paper / no ink / paper jam conditions

---

## Response Expectations

This project prioritizes:

- Stability
- Reproducibility
- Safe changes

Support responses may focus on narrowing down root causes rather than quick fixes.
